name: Establish sourced mechanical and side constraints for block placement
description_html:
Bounded prerequisite to AGENTEE-472. Agent-449 reconciles existing mechanical/RF evidence and selects one existing holder; all communication through 519. Same frozen fome-mc 46c7c730 and ROUTE-3 08066170 baseline as the source trace. Budget 30 minutes; use existing evidence first, targeted primary-source verification where needed; no broad research campaign.

Return a compact constraint register for fixed mechanical/interface anchors; screw heads/washers/standoffs; connector bodies and assembly/tool access; antenna/RF and In1 no-track limits; enclosure/thermal restrictions; per-face courtyards, heights and test access. Each entry needs actual geometry/face or explicit unknown, exact source/provenance, and whether it is owner/manufacturer/mechanical requirement or agent heuristic. Trace double-sided permission in REQUIREMENTS.md and the existing 0.5 mm courtyard-edge setting without inventing a replacement margin. Identify the affected blocks/components and missing facts that block placement versus final release.

No purchase, fabrication order, project upload, owner-constraint relaxation, new enclosure assumption or board mutation. Missing source remains unknown; request an owner decision through 519 only where it is actually owner-reserved. Stop at 30 minutes with the register and material uncertainties. Provide candidate-bound checking requirements for before-packing and final saved coordinates.
